nodes.name: Moog Sub 37 Paraphonic Synthesizer
nodes.description: Paraphonic analog synthesizer featuring two variable-waveshape oscillators, a classic Moog ladder filter with multi-drive saturation, and dual DAHDSR loopable envelopes. The definitive bass engine for melodic techno.

nodes.name: Roland Space Echo RE-201
nodes.description: Legendary 1974 analog magnetic tape delay and spring reverb unit. Generates warm harmonic saturation, subtle tape wow/flutter, and self-oscillating resonant dub feedback loops essential for ambient and dub acoustics.

attributes.synthesis_type: Magnetic Tape Delay with 3 Playback Heads

nodes.name: Roland TB-303 Bass Line
nodes.description: Iconic 1981 analog bass synthesizer with diode ladder filter and accent circuitry. Accidental misuse of its cutoff and resonance knobs birthed acid house in Chicago and revolutionized global rave culture.

nodes.name: Roland TR-808 Rhythm Composer
nodes.description: Transistorized analog rhythm machine introduced by Roland in 1980. Its booming sine-wave decay kick and crisp hand-clap became the sonic foundation for hip-hop, trap, Miami bass, and modern pop.

nodes.name: Roland TR-909 Rhythm Composer
nodes.description: 1983 punchy drum machine powering four-on-the-floor Detroit techno, Euro-dance, and French Touch house anthems.

nodes.name: Sequential Prophet-6
nodes.description: Sequential's modern tribute to the vintage Prophet-5, featuring true voltage-controlled analog oscillators, classic four-pole resonant low-pass filters, and poly-mod routing for rich analog chords and warm pads.

nodes.name: Solid State Logic SSL 4000 G+ Console
nodes.description: Industry-standard analog console famed for punchy dynamics, surgical EQ curves, and the legendary G-Series stereo master bus compressor.

nodes.name: Neve 8078 Custom Discrete Recording Console
nodes.description: Rupert Neve's pinnacle discrete analog mixing desk delivering massive headroom, musical harmonic warmth, and transformer saturation.

nodes.name: Funktion-One Resolution 5 Sound System
nodes.description: Pioneering horn-loaded point-source club loudspeaker system engineered by Tony Andrews. Eliminates harsh high-frequency compression distortion to deliver pure physical transient punch and low-frequency bass impact without listener fatigue.
